name: aura-apps
description: Aura Apps skills for reading Aura and Karma Confluence macros

interface.shortDescription: Read Aura and Karma Confluence macros
interface.longDescription: Skills and references for extracting visible content from Aura and Karma Confluence macros, including Forge/Connect parameter handling, per-macro parsing references, and Confluence link resolution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the Aura Apps macro reader skill to extract content from a Confluence page containing Aura or Karma macros.
